caption:
# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Thunderbird Mail" on the left and "Important - Local Folders - Mozilla Thunderbird" in the center.
- **System Information**: Shows the date and time "Oct 23 00:25" in the center of the header.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the far right, includes icons for:
  - System settings or notifications
  - Volume control
  - Power button
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the far right, includes:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)

- **Application Launcher Icons**: A vertical dock on the far left with icons for:
  - Google Chrome
  - Firefox
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark icon)
  - Trash (recycle bin icon)
  - Settings (gear icon)
  - App Grid (grid of dots icon)
- **Thunderbird Navigation Panel**:
  - **Email Account**: Displays "mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com" with a folder icon.
  - **Local Folders**: A collapsible folder with subfolders:
    - Trash (with trash can icon)
    - Outbox (with envelope icon)
    - Important (highlighted with yellow folder icon)
  - **New Message Button**: A blue button labeled "+ New Message" with a plus icon.
  - **More Options Button**: A three-dot button next to the "New Message" button.

## Main Content Area

- **Folder Header**: Displays "Important" with "0 Messages" next to it.
- **Search Bar**: A search field with placeholder text "Search..." and keyboard shortcut "CTRL + K".
- **Quick Filter Button**: A button labeled "Quick Filter" with a filter icon.
- **Empty Message List**: The main area is blank, indicating no messages are present in the "Important" folder.

## Right Panel (Welcome Screen)

- **Welcome Message**: Large text "Welcome to FREEDOM" with a subtitle: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."
- **Donate Button**: A blue button with a heart icon labeled "Donate" and the text "Help keep Thunderbird alive!" below it.
- **Two Information Cards**:
  - **Free and Open Source Card**:
    - Title: "Free and Open Source"
    - Subtitle: "Thunderbird is now yours forever."
    - Description: "Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely. Our software license protects your right to use, modify, and share Thunderbird. Our mission is to protect your privacy and freedom."
    - Button: "Get Help" with a heart icon.
  - **Powered by Community Card**:
    - Title: "Powered by Community"
    - Subtitle: "You can become part of our story."
    - Description: "Anyone can contribute to Thunderbird. By donating, translating, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, and more, you make Thunderbird better for yourself and the world."
    - Button: "Participate" with a pencil icon.
- **Feature Announcement**: A rounded rectangle with text: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release." with "Thunderbird Release" as a hyperlink.

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Status Indicator**: Displays "( ) Done" at the bottom left corner.
